notes: When saying what you are busy with, follow 'zajęty' with the instrumental case (e.g., 'Jestem zajęty pracą' – I am busy with work).

senses.definition: Of a person: having a lot of work or things to do; not having free time.

examples.text: Jestem dzisiaj bardzo zajęty w pracy.
examples.translation: I am very busy at work today.
examples.emotion: stressed and rushing to finish tasks before the deadline

senses.definition: Of a place, seat, or phone line: currently in use; not free or available.

examples.emotion: polite and inquiring while looking for a place to sit

draftBefore.emotion: hurried and focused, with no time to stop
notes: Zajęty has two main meanings: being busy with work or tasks, and something being occupied (like a seat or a restroom).
Do not confuse zajęty (busy/occupied) with zamknięty (closed).
